title: A 是 B — ‘A is B’
description: Use 是 to link a subject and a noun, meaning ‘to be’.
examples: 我是學生 (Wǒ shì xuéshēng.) — I am a student.
他是老師 (Tā shì lǎoshī.) — He is a teacher.

practice.prompt: Reorder: 是 / 他 / 學生
Make a sentence: We are friends.

title: Counting with Measure Words
description: When counting objects or people in Chinese, a measure word (量詞) is placed between the number and the noun. The most common and general measure word is 個. The pattern is: Number + 個 + Noun.
examples: 一個人 (yí gè rén) — one person
三個學生 (sān gè xuéshēng) — three students
四個老師 (sì gè lǎoshī) — four teachers
五個朋友 (wǔ gè péngyǒu) — five friends

practice.prompt: Reorder: 學生 / 三 / 個

title: Using 「兩」 Before Measure Words
description: In Chinese, when saying 'two' before a measure word, use 兩 (liǎng) instead of 二 (èr). This only applies when a measure word follows the number. For example, say 兩個人 (two people), not 二個人.
examples: 兩個人 (liǎng gè rén) — two people
兩個老師 (liǎng gè lǎoshī) — two teachers
兩個學生 (liǎng gè xuéshēng) — two students
兩個朋友 (liǎng gè péngyǒu) — two friends

practice.prompt: Reorder: 老師 / 兩 / 個
